title: Control-effectiveness evaluation coverage
summary: Share of controls in the operator's effectiveness-test scope that produced at least one effectiveness-test evaluation in the rollup window. A direct measure of how much of the control catalog the rollup can score; coverage gaps surface as silent zeros in the board summary if not tracked.

target.rationale: Coverage floor below which the programme-level control-effectiveness score becomes statistically unreliable.

measurement.formula: 100 * count(distinct control_ref with >=1 effectiveness-test evaluation in window) / count(distinct control_ref in scope).

inputs.name: tests
inputs.description: control attestation records carrying effectiveness-test evaluations

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: catalog governance entry pinning which controls are in effectiveness-test scope for the window

external_refs.name: NIST SP 800-53 PM-6 Measures of Performance
